title: More Agents, More Samples, or More Thinking? Untangling Coordination, Ensembling, and Test-Time Compute in Multi-Agent LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.17610v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evaluations of multi-agent language models often compare communicating architectures against a single greedy pass. This practice confounds coordination with sample multiplicity and inference compute. We synthesize nine primary empirical evaluations comprising 516 unique multi-agent configurations organized along a resource vector R with six dimensions and a baseline ladder with four categories. Against baselines with a single pass (Category A), multi-agent accuracy differences are negative overall and near zero when omitting the largest contributing study. When evaluated against baselines matched on sample count (Category B) or resource budget (Category C), multi-agent systems average -0.042 in accuracy, and multilevel random effects modeling on the log odds scale remains negative across sensitivity checks. Multi-agent accuracy equals or falls below the baseline in 74% of these comparable contrasts, and study means are nonpositive in alm

translated_title: 更多智能体、更多样本，还是更多思考？解耦多智能体大语言模型中的协调、集成与测试时计算
translated_abstract: 多智能体语言模型的评估通常将具有通信机制的架构与单次贪婪推理进行比较，这种做法将协调效应与样本数量和推理计算量混为一谈。本文综合了九项主要实证评估，涵盖516个独特的多智能体配置，沿一个包含六个维度的资源向量R进行组织，并构建了包含四个类别的基线阶梯。与单次推理基线（A类）相比，多智能体的准确率差异总体为负，在剔除贡献最大的一项研究后接近于零。当与按样本数量（B类）或资源预算（C类）匹配的基线进行比较时，多智能体系统的平均准确率差异为-0.042，且基于对数几率尺度的多层随机效应建模在各项敏感性检验中均保持负值。在74%的可比对比中，多智能体系统的准确率等于或低于基线，且各研究的均值几乎均为非正值。
tldr: 本研究通过综合516个多智能体配置的元分析发现，多智能体大语言模型的表现优势主要来自额外的样本数量和测试时计算量，而非智能体间的协调机制本身——在与资源匹配的单模型基线公平对比时，多智能体系统在74%的情况下并无优势甚至更差。
en_tdlr: This meta-analysis of 516 multi-agent LLM configurations reveals that coordination itself provides no accuracy gains once sample count and test-time compute are matched, with multi-agent systems performing equal to or worse than single-model baselines in 74% of fair comparisons.
